title: Classic Guacamole Avocado

seo.title: Classic Guacamole Recipe: Easy & Authentic Avocado Dip
seo.metaDescription: Learn how to make the best classic guacamole recipe at home! This easy, authentic Mexican avocado dip is perfect for parties. Get step-by-step instructions.
seo.h1: Classic Guacamole Recipe: The Best Homemade Avocado Dip
seo.imageAlt: Bowl of classic guacamole with fresh avocado, lime, cilantro, and red onion, served with tortilla chips
seo.imageCaption: Whip up this easy classic guacamole recipe for your next gathering – it's always a crowd-pleaser!

description: Experience the true taste of Mexico with this authentic classic guacamole recipe. Made with ripe avocados, fresh lime, cilantro, and a hint of spice, it is the perfect creamy and flavorful dip for any occasion. This beloved appetizer brings vibrant flavors to your table, ideal for sharing with friends and family.

ingredients.notes: finely minced (remove seeds for less heat)

instructions.title: Prepare the Avocados
instructions.text: In a medium bowl, add the scooped-out avocado flesh. Using a fork or a potato masher, gently mash the avocados to your desired consistency. Some prefer it smooth, while others like it chunky.

instructions.title: Add Fresh Lime Juice
instructions.text: Pour the fresh lime juice over the mashed avocados immediately. The lime not only adds a zesty flavor but also helps prevent the avocados from browning. Stir gently to combine.

instructions.title: Incorporate Aromatics
instructions.text: Add the finely diced red onion, chopped fresh cilantro, and minced serrano pepper to the avocado mixture. These ingredients are key to the classic Mexican flavor profile.

instructions.title: Season with Salt
instructions.text: Sprinkle the sea salt over the mixture. Start with 1/2 teaspoon and gently fold all the ingredients together until well combined. The salt enhances all the other flavors.

instructions.title: Taste and Adjust
instructions.text: Taste the guacamole and adjust the seasoning as needed. You might want to add more salt, lime juice, or even a tiny bit more serrano pepper for extra kick, according to your preference.

instructions.title: Serve Immediately
instructions.text: Transfer the classic guacamole to a serving bowl. For best flavor and to prevent browning, serve it immediately with warm tortilla chips, vegetable sticks, or as a side dish with your favorite Mexican meals.

tips: For truly authentic guacamole, mash the avocados in a molcajete to release their natural oils and create a richer, more rustic texture.
Always use ripe Hass avocados; they should yield slightly to gentle pressure. If you prefer less heat, remove the seeds and veins from the serrano or jalapeño pepper before mincing.
To prevent browning if not serving immediately, press plastic wrap directly onto the surface of the guacamole before refrigerating. A thin layer of lime juice on top can also help.
